participants.name: Personal Customer
participants.involvement: Triggering persona for customer-initiated DDI setup via digital channel. Receives notifications throughout the DDI lifecycle. May file indemnity claim under the Direct Debit Guarantee.

touchpoints.interaction: Customer navigates to Direct Debits section, selects 'Add Direct Debit', enters originator details or scans a mandate QR code, reviews DDI summary (originator name, amount type, estimated first collection date), and completes SCA to authorise the instruction.
information_disclosed_to_participant: Originator name and Service User Number (SUN)
Amount type (fixed or variable)
Estimated first collection date (if provided by originator)
Direct Debit Guarantee rights summary (brief disclosure at setup)
information_collected_from_participant: SCA completion (FIDO2 biometric or TOTP) — for digital channel initiated setup only
Confirmation of intent to set up the Direct Debit

touchpoints.interaction: Customer receives confirmation that their Direct Debit has been successfully set up. Notification includes BACS reference, originator name, and the Direct Debit Guarantee summary (mandatory disclosure of indemnity claim rights).
information_disclosed_to_participant: Confirmation: Direct Debit is now active
BACS reference for the mandate
Originator name
First collection date (if known)
Direct Debit Guarantee: 'If an error is made in the payment of your Direct Debit, by the originator or your bank, you are entitled to a full and immediate refund of the amount paid from your bank.'
How to cancel or dispute a Direct Debit

touchpoints.channel: Push notification / Email / In-app upcoming transactions
touchpoints.interaction: Customer receives advance notice of upcoming collection 2 working days before the debit (D-2). Can view pending collection in the digital channel upcoming transactions section.
information_disclosed_to_participant: Originator name
Amount to be collected
Collection date (D-0)
Account to be debited (masked: XX-XX-XX XXXXXXXX)

touchpoints.interaction: Customer sees debit in transaction feed on collection date. Receives post-collection notification. If collection failed, receives unpaid DD notification.
information_disclosed_to_participant: Happy path: Amount debited, originator name, collection date, transaction reference
Exception (insufficient funds): Amount that could not be collected, originator name, advice to ensure sufficient funds, Direct Debit Guarantee rights reminder

touchpoints.interaction: Customer contacts the bank to file an indemnity claim under the Direct Debit Guarantee. Customer identifies the disputed collection. Bank credits account immediately and unconditionally.
information_disclosed_to_participant: Confirmation of immediate credit: amount credited, date
Whether the mandate has been cancelled (if requested)
BACS indemnity claim reference
Timeline for recovery from originator (customer information only)
information_collected_from_participant: Identification of disputed collection (originator name, amount, date)
Claim reason (free text — no evidence required under DD Guarantee)
Whether customer wants the mandate cancelled

participants.name: Direct Debit Originator
participants.description: A BACS-registered organisation (e.g. utility company, subscription provider, local authority) holding a BACS Service User Number (SUN). The originator initiates the DDI via AUDDIS and submits collection files via BACS at D-2.
participants.involvement: Submits AUDDIS 0N (new instruction) or AUDDIS 0C (cancellation). Submits BACS collection files at D-2 for each collection cycle.

touchpoints.interaction: Originator submits AUDDIS 0N file to BACS. SVC-009 receives the instruction and creates ENT-034.
Originator submits collection file at D-2 containing the Direct Debit instruction (amount, collection date, reference). SVC-009 creates ENT-035 (DirectDebitCollection) with status = submitted.

participants.name: BACS / Vocalink (Pay.UK Infrastructure)
participants.description: The BACS payment scheme infrastructure operated by Vocalink (Mastercard) under Pay.UK governance. Provides the AUDDIS service for DDI registration and the BACS processing infrastructure for collection settlement.
participants.involvement: Routes AUDDIS 0N instructions. Processes collection files. Returns ARUDD for unpaid DDs. Provides ADDACS notifications for mandate amendments and cancellations.

touchpoints.interaction: SVC-009 submits AUDDIS 0N to Vocalink. BACS validates originator SUN, routes instruction to paying bank (the bank itself as paying PSP). BACS confirms acceptance.
BACS confirms DDI registration (ADDACS notification or implicit AUDDIS acceptance). SVC-009 updates ENT-034.status = active.
BACS delivers originator collection file at D-2. SVC-009 processes file and creates ENT-035.
BACS settles collected DDs on D-0. For returns: SVC-009 submits ARUDD return to BACS. Originator is notified of unpaid DD by BACS.

participants.name: Payment Operations Team
participants.description: Internal bank operations team responsible for BACS scheme participation, file processing oversight, and exception handling.
participants.involvement: Monitors BACS file processing. Handles exceptions (AUDDIS rejections, ARUDD returns, indemnity recovery). Manages BACS scheme participation obligations.

touchpoints.interaction: Monitors AUDDIS validation failures and BACS rejection notifications. Escalates to customer service for customer notification on validation failures.
Manages bulk ARUDD returns if systemic issues arise. Monitors unpaid DD volumes.
Monitors indemnity claims. Initiates BACS indemnity recovery from originators. Manages disputes where originator contests the indemnity claim.
